title: Auditory Brainstem Response Data Preprocessing Method for the Automatic Classification of Hearing Loss Patients
summary: The VGG16 pipeline classifies hearing-loss patients from processed auditory-response recordings. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Department of Software Convergence, Soonchunhyang University, Asan 31538, Republic of Korea

evidence.tested: The VGG16 pipeline classifies hearing-loss patients from processed auditory-response recordings. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.
